visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A baby girl with short black hair and a pink shirt sits in a light purple high chair. She wears a yellow silicone bib with a circular pattern and a brand name. She holds a long, white and green onion stalk, chewing on it with a focused expression in a bright kitchen environment. (2) The camera pans to the side to show a young girl with pigtails wearing a white school-style uniform with brown collar. She takes a bite of a green onion stalk while sitting at a table near a kitchen counter. (3) The view returns to the baby. An adult's hand enters the frame, holding more green onion stalks and offering one to the baby. The baby reaches out with small hands to take it, then puts it in her mouth to chew. (4) The older girl is shown again from a similar angle. She holds the green onion, looks at it, and talks to the person behind the camera with animated facial expressions and hand movements. (5) The camera switches back to the baby who is now crying intensely. Her face is red, eyes squinted, and mouth open wide in a loud wail. She waves her hands slightly in the air while still in the high chair. (6) A final scene shows a static graphic background in light yellow. A cartoon illustration of two girls, one lying down and one standing, appears above the text 'CUI'S FAMILY LIFE' in white capital letters.
